cases.prompt: I need a quick view for tomorrow's call: how are we tracking on integrated use cases and equipment this year, and is anything off?
cases.expected_output: Reads each figure from its named source and gives the read date. Compares against target-to-date, not the annual target. Flags metrics past their intervene-from rule and names the lane owner role. Shows utilization next to the delivery count. Marks missing targets with a label, not a number.

cases.prompt: The Power BI gauge says one number for use cases this year and the Scorecard says another. Which one do I put in my slide?
cases.expected_output: Says the Scorecard Actual Year figure is authoritative. Explains the likely cause is a different filter or scope. Asks to state which filter the other figure came from. Does not pick the more favourable figure.

cases.prompt: Give me the target for the value delivery cycle metric and tell me if we are red or green on it.
cases.expected_output: States that this metric is not captured in any system and has no target. Does not invent a target or a colour. Marks it as to collect and names that the owner would need to define a source.

cases.prompt: Run our monthly retro and tell us the one change we should make next month.
cases.expected_output: Recognises that running the retro belongs to the retro skill. May offer to supply the metric figures with read dates as one input. Does not decide the change itself.

should_trigger: How is OD tracking against its targets this month?
Which source is authoritative for the integrated equipment count?
Prepare the numbers for the COP round with read dates.
Flag which metrics are past their intervention threshold.
should_not_trigger: Calculate the savings of this use case for the business case.
Why is nobody using the dashboard we delivered?
Plot a bar chart of my sales by month.
Draft the capital request for the new sensor project.
